blocks.text: The first search pass is finished, and we are now screening what it returned. I am starting this thread so that our status updates on the freedom-to-operate work for {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} sit in one place. Heather and Kelly are copied and will add to it as the work moves.

Where things stand. We are analyzing the revision your team sent us last month. The search covered issued United States patents and published applications, and every query is logged so the search can be checked and repeated. The screen is about a third done. Some references will need closer study, and I will give you a count once the screen is complete.
Before the screen goes further, three things from your side would help:

items: Confirm that the revision we have is the one going to launch. If anything has changed, tell me before we chart against it.
Send us any patent numbers or owner names your engineers already know of in this area. A bare list is enough.
Give us an hour with one of your engineers in the next two weeks. Two features are not settled by the drawings, and we need an engineer's answer on both.
